starter.name: Digger
starter.summary: Strong arms, a long day and a lucky hand. Wakes with a trowel. Wears patched clothes; fine attire is earned through valley achievements.
intro: You wake south of the broken bridge at noon, a trowel in your hand.
The bank slid in the night. Something hard lies in the turned earth.
Dig it out, then make for the bridge: its keystone lies in the shallows.
